name: Assetto Corsa
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Runs AssettoServer, the open-source Assetto Corsa server built for freeroam, with AI traffic and plugins; no Steam account needed. Your cfg and content folders, as Content Manager packs them, are kept.
startup: if [ -z "{{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}" ]; then echo "AssettoServer needs an admin password. Set Admin password in Startup, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; exec ./AssettoServer

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Assetto Corsa, run by AssettoServer: downloads the chosen release for this node's CPU from its
# GitHub releases (checked against GitHub's SHA-256 when GitHub shows one).
# cfg, content and your own plugins are never touched; a starting
# server_cfg.ini and entry_list.ini are written only when there are none.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=compujuckel/AssettoServer
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case $(uname -m) in
x86_64) asset=assetto-server-linux-x64.tar.gz ;;
aarch64) asset=assetto-server-linux-arm64.tar.gz ;;
*) fail "AssettoServer isn't built for $(uname -m) CPUs." ;;
esac

want="${VERSION:-latest}"
tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null) ||
    fail "AssettoServer has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null || echo v0.0.54)."
gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' ||
    fail "AssettoServer's release $tag has no download for this CPU ($asset)."

if [ "$(cat .raptor-assettoserver 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $asset" ] && [ -x AssettoServer ]; then
    echo "AssettoServer $tag is already installed."
else
    build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
    rm -rf "$build"; mkdir -p "$build/x"
    trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
    echo "Downloading AssettoServer $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/server.tar.gz" || fail "The download of AssettoServer failed. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$build/server.tar.gz" -C "$build/x"
    [ -f "$build/x/AssettoServer" ] || fail "AssettoServer's download has no server in it."
    chmod +x "$build/x/AssettoServer"
    cp -a "$build/x/." .
    echo "$tag $asset" > .raptor-assettoserver
fi

mkdir -p cfg content
if [ ! -f cfg/server_cfg.ini ]; then
    cat > cfg/server_cfg.ini <<'INI'
[SERVER]
NAME=AssettoServer
CARS=ks_mazda_miata
TRACK=magione
CONFIG_TRACK=
SUN_ANGLE=16
PASSWORD=
ADMIN_PASSWORD=
UDP_PORT=9600
TCP_PORT=9600
HTTP_PORT=8081
MAX_CLIENTS=8
REGISTER_TO_LOBBY=1
PICKUP_MODE_ENABLED=1
LOOP_MODE=1
CLIENT_SEND_INTERVAL_HZ=18
ABS_ALLOWED=1
TC_ALLOWED=1
FUEL_RATE=100
DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER=100
TYRE_WEAR_RATE=100
ALLOWED_TYRES_OUT=2
LEGAL_TYRES=

[PRACTICE]
NAME=Practice
TIME=600
IS_OPEN=1

[WEATHER_0]
GRAPHICS=3_clear
BASE_TEMPERATURE_AMBIENT=20
BASE_TEMPERATURE_ROAD=7
VARIATION_AMBIENT=1
VARIATION_ROAD=1
INI
fi
if [ ! -f cfg/entry_list.ini ]; then
    for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do
        printf '[CAR_%s]\nMODEL=ks_mazda_miata\nSKIN=\nSPECTATOR_MODE=0\nDRIVERNAME=\nTEAM=\nGUID=\nBALLAST=0\nRESTRICTOR=0\n\n' "$i"
    done > cfg/entry_list.ini
fi
echo "Installed AssettoServer $tag. Upload your cars and track to content, or a Content Manager server pack, then start the server."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The AssettoServer release to install, such as v0.0.54, or latest. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name shown in the server list.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players need to join. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password that makes a player an admin in game. The server won't start without one.

variables.name: HTTP port
variables.description: A second port the server needs for Content Manager and the server list; add it as an allocation.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players that can be connected at once, up to the cars in entry_list.ini.
